NECK AND BACK. [31] [Con.]
Tightness in nape of neck ; pain and stiffness.
Soreness in lower cervical vertebræ.
Pain as from a sprain in left side of back and neck.
Enormously enlarged cervical glands. θ Caries lower jaw.
Cervical glands hard and tender.
Indurated and swollen cervical glands in scrofulous children.
Neck twisted by hard swelling to right shoulder. θ After scarlatina.
Herpetic eruption on neck and behind ears, < from heat, which causes a burning sensation.
Pain between shoulders and in lumbar region.
Weakness and lameness in small of back and subsequent lassitude.
Dragging pain in small of back. θ Uterine disorder.
Stitches in small of back, with drawing through lumbar vertebræ, while standing.
Contraction in back, with sensation of coldness, griping and sore feeling.
Sharp pains in back, with chills. θ Dysmenorrhœa.
Dorsal pain between shoulders and in lumbar region.
Peculiar tumor in central part of back, as large as a cherry, growing on half an inch long pedicle ; tumor and pedicle of a bluish color.
Pain in back, especially on bending backward, or after a short walk, with nausea and weariness.
Lancinating pains and weight in back, hips and lower part of abdomen, extending from womb and ovaries. θ Uterine polypi.
Stitches and tensive drawing pains, much increased by moving arms upward ; severe aching in sacral region from walking a short distance, followed by nausea and lassitude ; stitches in sacrum when standing, with drawing through lumbar vertebræ.
After falling from a height upon back, acute pain in lower part and in region of small of back, especially when laughing, sneezing, or taking a quick breath.
Ill effects of bruises and shocks to spine.
Coccyodynia.
Upon buttocks small, scattered, flat, wart-like, greyish-brown growths of hypertrophied epidermis. θ Enlargement of liver.
   

UPPER LIMBS. [32] [Con.]
Shoulders feel bruised and sore.
Axillary glands swollen. θ Mammary tumor.
Arms when lifted fall like inert masses and remain immovable.
Humid tetters on forepart of arm.
Ichorous, biting, burning herpes on hands and forearms.
Cracking in wrist joint.
Sweat of palms of hands.
Itching on dorsum of finger.
Yellow spots on fingers.
Yellow nails.
   

LOWER LIMBS. [33] [Con.]
Drawing pain in hips.
Uneasiness in lower limbs.
Dragging and weakness in legs.
Pressing downward and drawing in thighs, scanty menses.
Numbness in thighs.
Sensation of weakness even to trembling, in right thigh while walking.
Staggering gait.
Painless loss of power in lower limbs ; faltering, vacillating gait ; staggers as if drunk, dragging his legs after him.
Lassitude in knees.
Pain in knee as from fatigue.
Herpetic eruption over popliteal space.
Pain going from hypogastric region down legs. θ Dysmenorrhœa.
Cracking of knee joint.
Cramps of calves.
Red spots on calves, turning yellow or green, as from contusion, preventing movement.
Liability of feet to catch cold from slight exposure.
Pustule on foot.
   

LIMBS IN GENERAL. [34] [Con.]
Heaviness and sense of weariness in all limbs.
Limbs feel bruised.
Paralyzed feeling in all limbs.
Difficulty in using limbs ; unable to walk.
Unpainful lameness ; trembling of limbs.
Weakness and debility, especially of arms and legs.
Shooting pains through arms and legs. θ Uterine disorder.
Paralysis of lower, afterward of upper extremities, or the reverse.
Numbness of fingers and toes, the former looking as if they were dead.
All the joints pain as if beaten.
Piercing and tearing pains through extremities and in joints, particularly in elbows and hip joints.
Coldness of hands and feet.
Sensation as if bones of upper and lower extremities were surrounded by tight bands ; periostitis, with throbbing and burning pain, as if from an ulceration, < in morning and at night, also when standing, lying, or lifting the part, > when letting limb hang down and from motion ; r. side, or left upper and right lower.
   

REST. POSITION. MOTION. [35] [Con.]
Rest : > noise in larynx and twitchings of face.
Patient wishes to keep head perfectly still.
Letting limb hang down : > pain.
Lying down : vertigo < ; hydrocephalus, pains > ; aching in right eye ; cough < ; powerful, spasmodic paroxysms of cough < ; dry, tearing cough < ; dry, hacking, almost continuous cough < ; pain in bones <.
Must lie down : tearing in head.
Lying in bed : sick headache <.
Lying on side : <.
Recumbent position : tearing in temple and sides of head <.
Sitting : pressure in neck of bladder, with stitches > ; sharp thrusts directly through chest from sternum to spine ; sweat while dozing ; pain in ulcer.
Is obliged to sit up and cough it out, after which rest.
Patient < after going to bed, is obliged to sit up or walk about to get relief.
Standing : bearing down in uterus < ; stitches in small of back, with drawing through lumbar vertebræ ; pain in bones < ; stitches in sacrum ; pain in ulcer.
Knee-elbow position : violent pains in stomach better.
Motion : tearing in temples and sides of head < ; headache, with pains all over chest < ; aching in abdomen after going to bed, during pregnancy > ; pain in bones > ; pain in ulcer < ; > parts affected ; symptoms at first <, > by continued.
Changing position in bed : dry, tearing cough worse.
When turning in bed : vertigo worse.
When rising from bed : violent palpitation.
Rising from seat : vertigo.
Closing eyes : hydrocephalus, pains > ; black spots seen.
When looking around : vertigo.
Moving head : headache, with coryza > ; semilateral headache worse.
Raising head : vomiting during pregnancy worse.
On bending head forward : heaviness in occiput.
When turning head : vertigo.
When shaking head : painful sensation of looseness ; pain from brow to occiput, as if something had become detached.
Moving arms upward : stitches and drawing pains in back worse.
Bending backward : pain in back.
Stooping : vertigo < ; headache, with coryza > ; tearing in temples and sides of head worse.
Walking : complete indifference, takes no interest in anything ; vertigo < ; clicking in left vertex, also in occiput ; feeling of coldness in eyes ; staggers as if drunk ; drawing in sound teeth ; involuntary swallowing ; soreness and rawness of stomach and abdomen ; pressure in neck of bladder, with stitches < ; bearing down in uterus < ; soreness in breasts before menses < ; cough during pregnancy < ; shortness of breath ; stitches in r. side of chest, about nipple ; violent stitches in left side of chest, above nipple ; pain in back after ; aching in sacral region ; weakness, even to trembling in right thigh ; great weakness after ; noise is felt at every step, as of the breaking of a finger nail ; as if paralyzed after ; sudden loss of strength while ; staggering when ; after standing, > by.
Downward motion : vertigo worse.
On ascending an eminence : pains in ulcer worse.
Exercise : want of breath on taking least ; urticaria from violent.
Running : cough worse.
